description: Edit or combine 1-4 existing creative image assets (imageAssetIds, from creative_assets_list or a previous creative_image) with GPT Image (low quality), with an optional maskAssetId, and store the result as a new asset. The first call is a free price quote in credits; nothing is charged until you confirm. Show the user the credits and ask before calling again with confirm: true and the confirmationToken. Returns assets and creativeCredits. Use when the user wants to change or combine images already generated in this workspace.

briefId.description: Optional. The id of the creative brief this is for, from creative_brief_list. Leave it out when there is none, as for a request made in chat.

confirm.description: Set true only once the user has agreed to the quoted credits.

imageAssetIds.description: 1-4 image asset ids, from creative_assets_list or a previous creative_image.

maskAssetId.description: Optional. An image asset id, from creative_assets_list, to use as the edit mask.

name: creative_image_edit

confirmationToken.description: Pass this back with confirm: true to generate.

title: Edit Images
